description.en: Six pieces of soft, flaky mini parotas cooked to golden perfection. these small bite-sized layered breads are perfect for pairing with any curry.

Our faham chicken is marinated in a rich blend of middle eastern spices, fresh garlic, lemon juice, and aromatic herbs, then slow-grilled until perfectly tender and juicy. served with kubz, garlic sauce, and fresh salad.
A fragrant ghee rice set served with your choice of tender meat, spiced fish, succulent shrimp, or crab.
Our bestselling saffron rice meal, fragrant yellow rice served with a wider variety of flavorful vegetable sides and hearty meat options for a truly complete feast.

A delicious banana leaf-wrapped Ceylon meal, brings together fragrant rice, slow-cooked chicken curry, ash plantain, brinjal avial and a fried boiled egg with a fish cutlet, all infused with aromatic spices. steamed to perfection in the banana leaf, this traditional ceylonese delicacy offers a rich, flavorful experience. a must-try for those who enjoy wholesome, spice-infused meals

A wholesome North Indian vegetarian set featuring jeera rice, two soft chapatis, dal fry, and mixed vegetable sabji. choose between matar paneer or kadai paneer as your main curry. a balanced, satisfying north indian meal perfect for lunch, full of flavor and nourishment.

A hearty and flavorful North Indian lunch set featuring jeera rice, two soft chapatis, dal fry, and onion raita. choose your main curry: rich, creamy butter chicken or bold and aromatic kadai chicken. a complete north indian meal crafted for comfort and satisfaction.

Fragrant basmati rice gently tempered with cumin seeds and ghee, offering a light, aromatic flavor that pairs perfectly with dals, curries, or grilled dishes. simple, wholesome, and full of subtle spice - a classic north indian side dish.
Fluffy, steamed white rice fine-grain baarik for a light, delicate texture.
Aromatic, fluffy rice cooked gently in pure ghee for a rich, buttery flavor simple, fragrant, and the perfect base to pair with any curry or gravy.

Thayir vada - soft, fluffy lentil vada (fritters soaked in smooth, chilled yogurt and topped with a tempering of mustard seeds, curry leaves, and a sprinkle of spice. this south indian favorite is cooling, tangy, and absolutely refreshing - perfect as a light snack or side.

Medu vadai - crispy on the outside soft and fluffy on the inside - this delicious snack from south india is made from urad lentil batter marinated with spices and fried until golden brown - served with coconut chutney and sambar

Idiappam (string hopper) - soft, delicate rice noodles steamed into lacy discs, a traditional south indian and sri lankan favorite. light and fluffy, it pairs beautifully with coconut milk, kurma, or spicy curries - perfect for breakfast, dinner, or a light meal. simple, wholesome, and naturally gluten-free.
A crispy south indian dosa cooked to golden perfection and enriched with a generous drizzle of aromatic ghee. light, flavorful, and best enjoyed with sambar and fresh coconut chutney

name.en: Thenga (Coconut) Roti (One Piece) With Onion & Chili Sambol

description.en: A beloved sri lankan breakfast or snack featuring coconut roti - a flatbread made with freshly grated coconut and flour, pan-toasted for a slightly crisp edge and soft center. served with a fiery relish made from red chili, onion, lime, and maldive fish.
A thin, crispy dosa topped with finely chopped onions and green chilies, adding a sweet crunch and mild spice. served hot with sambar and coconut chutney for a flavorful south indian experience.

Idiyappam (string hoppers) - soft, delicate rice noodles steamed into lacy discs, a traditional south indian and sri lankan favorite. light and fluffy, idiyappam pairs beautifully with coconut milk, kurma, or spicy curries - perfect for breakfast, dinner, or a light meal. simple, wholesome, and naturally gluten-free.

Egg dosa - a delicious twist on the classic dosa. this crispy south indian crepe is topped with a freshly cracked egg, cooked right on the griddle. served with chutney and sambar, its a protein-packed, flavorful choice for any time of day

A fiery and flavorful sri lankan coconut relish made with freshly grated coconut, red chili, onion, lime juice, and a hint of maldive fish. bursting with spice and tang, pol sambol is the perfect sidekick to string hoppers, rice, or curries - a true island favorite.
